assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Obtuse triangle ABC with the obtuse angle at C and AB horizontal. Grey dashed extensions of BC and AC beyond C end at the feet D and E of the altitudes from A and B, each with a right-angle mark; F is the foot of the altitude from C on AB, with a right-angle mark. Blue dashed lines from A through D, from B through E and from F through C meet at the red point H above the triangle.

difficulty_rationale: An unstated approach requiring some exploration and a few connected steps.
